brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Current build has two bases: piece:0,0,0;half-n and piece:0,0,1;half-n stacked on level 1, which is an extra base on top. A single base as requested would be one full hex at q0 r0 level0 with no neighbours. Configurator was left in this stacked state.

Configurator offers no drawer sockets on a single full hex (0 sockets) and only 1 drawer on a single half hex. Notch/bay drawers require additional neighbouring cells which the brief forbids. Five drawers in a single isolated base is not offered by the system and was not built; current build has 0 drawers.

finish.summary: Build violates the single-base rule (two half-bases stacked) and provides no drawers. Five drawers in one isolated hex base is impossible in the Hex Cluster configurator: a full hex offers 0 drawer sites, a half hex offers 1.
